elements.desc: Upper-storey wall carrying the triple window (left part of the front, above the porch roof). Its top is the frieze under the hipped eave with shaped rafter tails; its foot dies into the lower (porch) roof. Its eave line falls steeply to the right in both photos: the wall recedes to the right (it is NOT parallel to the entry gable).

attrs.on: upper storey, left of the main gable

Outside corner with the triple-window wall at hero x 116 / p01 x 825 (woven shingle corner, a sunlit strip along it); inside corner with the near-frontal left-block face at hero x 46 / p01 x 791. Exposed shaped rafter tails under the upper-left eave (cream painted, curved / ogee undercut ends, ~1.4 m apart in hero perspective), with solid frieze blocks between them; one larger diagonal hip-rafter tail at the left corner.

Round screened vents in the frieze board between the upper-left rafter tails: two per bay along the triple-window eave (the right one of the last pair hidden by the corner tail at hero x ~700), three more in the recessed wall's frieze (hero x 748 / 776 / 802), ~7 cm dia.
Large diagonal hip-rafter tail / corner bracket at the left corner of the upper-left eave (cream).

Main front gable over the entry: wide flat cream rake boards (bargeboards, ~0.13 m face) with a small fascia/gutter line on top, deep overhang; boxed rake soffit with small purlin blocks. Right rake disappears into the birch.

Triangular louvred gable vent filling the main gable peak: dark brown horizontal louvres (~15 slats), split in two by the kingpost, framed below by the tie beam and above by the inner (truss) rafters.

notes: Coordinates are ORIGINAL pixels of the named photo (hero 2500x1875, p01 2500x1667); bboxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Edges read on 1.4-3.5x crops with 10-25 px ticks: good to ~3-6 px where an edge is crisp, ~10 px for trim lines in shade and for anything partly behind foliage.

Facade (left to right): upper storey = left block with a left-facing side gable (p01 only) | narrow corner face | triple-window wall under a hipped eave with shaped rafter tails and round frieze vents | shaded recessed wall with the downspout | main front gable (twin window, louvred vent, kingpost truss, knee braces) centred over the entry; right part hidden by the birches. Ground storey = wrap-around porch under a low asphalt roof with a cream box beam: left side run (C1-C3, p01), corner column C5, front run (C6), entry gable on two columns (C7, C8), front run right (C9 to corner C10), right side run (p01: three more columns).

Trim colour: cream / warm off-white everywhere (casings, rakes, brackets, beams, columns, gutters, downspouts, railings); window frames dark bronze / black; front door and its frame dark espresso-stained wood; siding grey cedar shingle (~5 in exposure, light blue-grey in sun, warm grey-brown in the porch shade).
Window pattern used throughout: units with a 2 x 2 divided upper part over a single large lower lite (4-over-1 look); no 6-over-1 seen.

No dentils anywhere: the eave friezes carry shaped rafter tails with round vents instead. No transom over the front door. No wall lanterns on the front; lights = entry ceiling light + two landscape path lights.

Scales: door leaf 179 x 397 px in hero (3 ft 6 in x 8 ft assumed => ~163 px/m at the door); shingle courses ~24 px at the upper triple window (~190 px/m there); entry risers ~30 px (~0.18 m), 4 risers => porch floor ~0.7 m above the walk.

Lighting: sun from the right-front (columns: left faces shaded, front faces lit); the porch interior and entry are in shade, so shingle / ceiling colours under the porch read darker and warmer than in sun.
Not recorded on purpose: the house number itself (only its plaque position).

Checked 2026-11-27 by overlaying every element on its photos at 2-6x: eave / rake polylines trace the TOP edge of the gutter / fascia; wall outlines run from the visible foot of the frieze / beam (where the shingles start) to the roof, railing or floor that hides them.

Outside corners are WOVEN shingle corners (no corner boards): upper bay corner hero x 116 / p01 x 825, porch-wall corner below it hero x 118 / p01 x 824, the plain section of the right porch wall hero x 2106 / 2313.

Upper-left plan as read from the shingle courses: left block front (near-frontal) -> inside corner (hero x 46 / p01 x 791) -> bay's left return (courses fall to the LEFT) -> outside corner (116 / 825) -> triple-window face (falls to the right, angled) -> inside corner (694 / 1100) -> recessed frontal wall -> main gable wall (866 / 1185). The ground floor repeats it: the W1 face (falls to the left) meets W2 at the corner under the bay (118 / 824).
open_questions: Upper-left bay: the triple-window wall PROJECTS (its left return, hero x 46-116 / p01 x 791-825, falls to the left, inside corner with the near-frontal left block at x 46 / 791). Open: the bay's plan angle relative to the main front (the triple face is not parallel to the entry gable) and its depth; the aerial / a camera solve should fix both.

Depths of the ground-floor porch walls (W1 face, W2 wall, entry wall, right wall with its plain section) and of the upper recessed wall are not measurable from these two photos; only their image outlines are given. The upper-left eave falls steeply to the right in both photos, so that wall is not parallel to the entry gable face.

The right half of the upper storey, the right main-gable knee brace and most of the right porch run are hidden by the birches; p01 shows three more columns along a right side run (col_rside_1..3) whose order in depth is unclear.
The white posts at the foot of the steps carry a sloped wedge on top: lower end of a sloped stair rail / cheek cap, or a decorative cap? No stair handrail is visible.
W2 / W3 / W4: French doors or tall windows (bottoms hidden by the railing); W2 may have a fourth unit behind column C6.
